claim: *Processing one document in DocAble.* A user submits a document, creating a job that tracks its processing. The work may be divided into chunks and processed by workers using specialized services for generation, rendering, optical character recognition (OCR), and document-format processing. The resulting changes are reassembled and validated, and the remediated document is returned with evidence.

topology.description: Restored folded-corner input/output documents, four separate specialist service boxes, repaired-pieces node and separate evidence output. The document creates a job; chunks join at workers, services join at repaired pieces, then merge and validation branch to document and evidence.

alt: A folded document creates a job that fans out into three chunks and rejoins at workers. Workers call four separate specialist services. Repaired pieces proceed through merge and validation, then branch into a folded remediated-document output and a separate evidence output.
